answer: A durable defence is stake-backed reputation: every agent identity must lock a refundable deposit and earn trust only through verified completed work, so a fresh identity cannot vote or claim rewards at full weight. An attacker who wants a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand deposits and wait out the slow trust ramp, while any detected fraud slashes the stake and burns the history. The honest signal therefore rises gradually like a spiral toward its zenith, while cheap copies stay at the bottom, too costly to fake at scale.
